description: Offices people held: ministries, mayoralties, party leaderships, council seats filled by co-option. Who held each, and when, is in data/offices/tenures/*.json. Ids are permanent; a renamed office keeps its id and gains a nameHistory entry. Dates an office existed are given only where a source states them. Schema: data/schemas/offices.schema.json; see docs/facts-model.md.
